Install or update everything (the plugin into your Hermes, and the app) with one command.

**Mac:**
```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/charuldalvi/hermes-one/main/install.sh | sh
```

**Windows** (PowerShell):
```powershell
irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/charuldalvi/hermes-one/main/install.ps1 | iex
```

Or download a zip below. The Mac app isn't notarised by Apple, so a copy downloaded in a browser needs right-click → Open the first time; the command above doesn't.
